text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
……To be worthy of the "Emperor", 
"perfection" and "absoluteness" prove to 
be this difficult.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
At times, I feel like closing my eyes to 
the naive immaturity of the ideals I hold 
so high.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... even so, even if that is true. 
I want to be "perfect." I want to be 
"absolute."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, please. I will endure 
whatever hardships come my way.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
choice_data_list: I'm gonna whip you into shape!
I'm gonna whip you into shape, okay!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
choice_data_list: I'm gonna whip you into shape!
I'm gonna whip you into shape, okay!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...No, the moment I let my emotions take 
over, I'm already far from "perfection," 
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thanks, that cleared my head a bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're always helping me out, aren't 
you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's no need for any hesitation 
between you and me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How can one fulfill an ideal without ever 
speaking of it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am the "Emperor," Symboli Rudolf. Next 
time, I will prove it beyond a shadow of a 
doubt!
